title: Optimization of ceramic content in nickel–alumina composite coatings obtained by low pressure cold spraying

preSprayedProperties.Majority_Powder_Source: Centre for Powder Spraying, Obninsk, Russia
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Production_Method: prepared by nickel hydrogen reduction method in the autoclave. Ammonium sulfate, nickel sulfate hexahydrate and ammonia were used in the synthesis as starting materials. The starting products were prepared as aqueous solution with pH ≈ 8. Alumina powder (KOS, Koło, Poland) was poured in the autoclave and activated with palladium chloride and anthraquinone. The cladding process was carried out under hydrogen pressure of 3 MPa at chamber temperature of 453 K
preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: substrates were initially degreased and grit-blasted with alumina powder having size about 850 μm prior to spraying.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: uniform without any defects, such as micro-cracks or large pores. The mixtures of powder K32 with cladded powders enabled obtaining coatings having different microstructures.
